consensus_summary: The grafting imagery of Romans 11 represents the inclusion of Gentile believers into God's covenant people (the olive tree), sharing in the promises given to Israel.
book_summary: Grafting represents the Gentile or stranger being received into the covenant tree.
consensus_core_identification: Inclusion of Gentiles into the covenant people/promises.
book_core_identification: The Gentile (wild branch) received into the covenant tree.
rationale: The book and consensus identify the exact same core meaning: Gentiles being incorporated into God's covenant people, drawing directly from Romans 11:17.
